'''Mestra''' was a sister of the [[Black Ajah]].

==Activities==
She partook in the battle against the [[White Tower]] and its allies in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''. She was killed by [[Egwene al'Vere]] with a ball of fire. If she was in her own body in ''Tel'aran'rhiod'' when she was killed, (which Darkfriends tend to do) her soul would be obliterated. It is likely, however, that she was using one of the stolen dream ''[[ter'angreal]]''.
